=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:897-909 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `_cached_row_needs_cancelled_failure_point_backfill` now reuses cached cancelled rows even when `failure_point` is empty, so jobs are not refetched for queue-only or pre-step cancellations.
  WHY: This leaves cancelled runs locationless when GitHub does provide a cancellation clue; other reviewers called the reuse intentional for no-clue cases, but these reviewers flagged it as violating the best-effort requirement.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:1520 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The reuse/backfill decision path never re-fetches current-version cancelled rows that still have an empty `failure_point`.
  WHY: x-ai says the version-gated logic only exercises stale-cache cases, so current-version empty-point rows converge to the wrong empty location and observability regresses.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Extend collector metrics so cancelled runs can carry a best-effort job/step point when GitHub job data identifies where cancellation happened. Keep existing `failure_point` field name for backward compatibility.
  expected_change_site: scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py compute_run_metrics / _cached_row_needs_cancelled_failure_point_backfill + tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: The short-circuit reuses empty-point cancelled rows when the run id is in `cancelled_jobs_seen_lookup`/`cancelled_jobs_seen_set`, so queue-only or pre-step cancelled runs remain locationless; mistralai says no test covers main() cancelled-run cache backfill behavior, and x-ai says the current-version queue-only empty-clue path is not covered.
- requirement: In scripts/drift_audit.sh, emit a stable `DRIFT_AUDIT_COVERAGE scanned=... fetched=... missing=... missing_run_ids=...` line and surface partial-coverage status in the run summary/notification path when missing logs are observed. Keep drift-audit fail-open.
  expected_change_site: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `_emit_coverage_summary()` exists and is called in some branches, but the final shell parser/step-summary path does not reliably surface partial coverage on error or early-exit paths; mistralai says the line is only called in the no-runs branch and per-run loop, and x-ai says the final summary/notification path does not reliably surface partial coverage.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:~897–909 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The guard at line ~897 now returns False for cached cancelled rows with empty failure_point when the run id is already in cancelled_jobs_seen_lookup, causing those rows to be reused without refetching jobs.
  WHY: This leaves queue-only or pre-step cancelled runs without a location even though the issue requires best-effort job/step points when GitHub exposes a clue.
- Requirement: Extend collector metrics so cancelled runs can carry a best-effort job/step point when GitHub job data identifies where cancellation happened. Keep the existing failure_point field name for backward compatibility rather than inventing a second parallel structure.
  Expected change site: scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py compute_run_metrics / _cached_row_needs_cancelled_failure_point_backfill
  Evidence of absence: The last-run change short-circuits reuse for empty-point cancelled rows when run id is in cancelled_jobs_seen_lookup, so queue-only/pre-step cancelled runs remain locationless even though GitHub may expose a cancellation clue.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: Add regression coverage for the cancelled-run case in tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py.
  Expected change site: tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py
  Evidence of absence: No test covers the collector’s main() cancelled-run code path or cache backfill behavior for queue-only/pre-step cancelled runs; only compute_run_metrics tests were added.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: In scripts/drift_audit.sh, emit a stable DRIFT_AUDIT_COVERAGE ... line and surface a partial-coverage status in the run summary/notification path when missing logs are observed.
  Expected change site: scripts/drift_audit.sh
  Evidence of absence: The emitted DRIFT_AUDIT_COVERAGE line is only called in the no-runs branch and the per-run loop, but not at the end of main() where the final summary is written; coverage is computed but never surfaced in the run summary or notifications.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_20 ===
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:897 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The short-circuit reuses a cached cancelled row that may have an empty `failure_point` without refetching `list_jobs_for_run()`.
  WHY: Queue-only or pre-first-step cancelled runs stay locationless in collector output, downstream reports, and drift-audit summaries; this directly regresses the "best-effort job/step point" requirement when GitHub provides a cancellation clue.
- scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:1520 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The backfill logic is gated on `cancelled_failure_point_version` but the test suite only exercises stale-cache cases; current-version empty-point rows are never re-fetched.
  WHY: Collector metrics for ongoing cancelled runs converge to the wrong (empty) location after the first cache write, breaking observability for the exact class of runs the issue targeted.
- Requirement: Extend collector metrics so cancelled runs carry a best-effort job/step point (keep existing `failure_point` field for backward compatibility). Add regression coverage for the cancelled-run case in tests/test_collect_workflow_logs.py.
  Expected change site: scripts/collect_workflow_logs.py:compute_run_metrics / _cached_row_needs_cancelled_failure_point_backfill + corresponding test in test_collect_workflow_logs.py
  Evidence of absence: The last-run change introduced a short-circuit that reuses empty-point cancelled rows without refetch (see line 897 guard and the new test that asserts empty point). This leaves the exact runs the issue targeted without a location; the prior PR iteration had the opposite bug. No test covers the current-version queue-only empty-clue path that now regresses observability.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: In scripts/drift_audit.sh, emit a stable DRIFT_AUDIT_COVERAGE scanned=... fetched=... missing=... missing_run_ids=... line and surface partial-coverage status in the run summary/notification path when missing logs are observed. Keep drift-audit fail-open.
  Expected change site: scripts/drift_audit.sh (main + summary emission)
  Evidence of absence: _emit_coverage_summary exists and is called in some branches, but the final shell parser and step-summary path do not reliably surface partial coverage on error or early-exit paths (see test_drift_audit_error_run_omits_uncomputed_coverage_summary). The acceptance criterion for explicit partial-coverage status in notifications/summaries is not met.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
